message.apothic_ascension.apex.incomplet: The Apex seal is unstable. Place four Ascension Pylons three blocks away on the cardinal axes.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.apex.p1: Place the Apex Ascension Bench at the center. Place one Ascension Pylon exactly three blocks north, east, south, and west on the same Y level.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.apex.p2: A valid structure projects the slow Ascension seal below the assembly and enables the bench and pylon gyros. Incomplete or standalone pieces stay visually dormant.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.apex.p3: The Apex Bench owns final Transcendent/Apotheotic material and gem advancement plus a five-choice pinnacle reforge: later choices sample more rolls and cost progressively more material, Sigils of Rebirth, and experience.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.diagnosti: Operators can use /apothic-ascension probe and the stage/combat command groups for targeted runtime diagnostics.
These commands inspect live gameplay state only; development qualification tooling is not included in release builds.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.focus.p1: Ascension affixes belong to Attack, Defense, Agility, Sustain, or Utility. The first native focus tends to lock later native rolls into the same family.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.focus.p2: Beta keeps large reserve pools behind every supported loot category so high-rarity generation can satisfy its requested affix count after family locking.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.focus.p3: Focus Sigils are first-party family reagents and the foundation for deliberate focus/evolution steering as the Beta line expands.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.footer: O: Open Codex • Right-click the Codex item
Apothic Ascension extends Apotheosis beyond Mythic with thirteen post-Mythic rarities, post-Perfect gem grades, focused affix families, staged progression, and first-party Ascension workstations.
The Codex is a compact in-game reference. It does not replace JEI; use it to understand progression rules, workstation roles, the Apex structure, and operator diagnostics.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.progressi: The rarity ladder is Legendary, Ancient, Forgotten, Primal, Stellar, Divine, Esoteric, Cataclysmic, Abyssal, Empyrean, Paracausal, Transcendent, and Apotheotic.
Natural progression is stage-limited. Locked advances through Ascendant, Celestial, Esoteric, Transcendent, and Apotheotic bands as qualifying materials and milestones are reached.
Ordinary Forge and Resonator paths stop before the final two steps. Paracausal to Transcendent and Transcendent to Apotheotic require the completed Apex multiblock.
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.subtitle: Field Reference
screen.apothic_ascension.codex.workstati: Ascension Forge: upgrades rarity materials and crafts Evolution Catalysts. The Ascension Core is reusable.
Gem Resonator: advances genuine Perfect Apotheosis gems while preserving gem identity and components. The Gem Ascension Matrix is reusable.
Affix Loom: combines first-party reagents into Attack, Defense, Agility, Sustain, or Utility Focus Sigils using the selected family button.
tooltip.apothic_ascension.compatibility_: Optional magic integrations are data-only and load only when their target mod is present.
tooltip.apothic_ascension.evolution_hint: Evolution affixes add compound, proc, and keystone build layers at higher Ascension rarities.
tooltip.apothic_ascension.focus_hint: Ascension affixes specialize toward a coherent build family.
